title: Semio React One Hook Per Entity Field Command
description: Refactor semio/client/lib/react/logic to one hook per entity (id), exactly one hook per field, and one useEntityCommand hook per entity aggregating all mutations with shared OperationStatus. Remove legacy per-operation exports and useUpdateDesign. Update sketchpad imports and vitest.
summary: Refactored @semio/react logic to CQRS: one id hook per entity, one field hook per field, and one command hook per entity (useKitCommand, useDesignCommand, useTypeCommand, useStoreCommand, useSessionCommand, usePiecesCommand, …) with shared EntityCommand { run, status }. Removed per-operation hooks and legacy useUpdateDesign. Added semioInternalCommandFactory. Updated sketchpad imports/usages and AGENTS.md. Vitest @semio/react: 5 passed.
